nodes.name: primePending
nodes.reachability: Pure view over campaign state; also called internally at `primePending` (CauldronSeeder.sol:240). nodes.name: deployedTargetWad
nodes.signature: function deployedTargetWad(uint64 startTs, uint64 window, uint256 nowTs, uint256 seedFloorWad) internal pure returns (uint256 wad)
nodes.reachability: The whole schedule. Linked into the seeder and called at `deployedTargetWad` (CauldronSeeder.sol:318) to size the next step and again at `deployedTargetWad` (CauldronSeeder.sol:328) to snap the bookkeeping, so both use identical inputs within one transaction.
